strings.name: Rory McIlroy
strings.summary: McIlroy's powerful driving and attacking play took him from Northern Ireland to world number one and titles at the US Open, PGA Championship and Open Championship. He completed the men's career Grand Slam at the 2025 Masters and retained that title in 2026, reaching six majors. On November 15, 2026 he claimed a record-tying eighth Race to Dubai crown; Tyrrell Hatton won the individual tournament.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: A major champion and world number one with influence on international golf and professional tours.
